name: ps2_hybrid
title: PS2 2D + 3D game starter
description: Full boot flow, editable 2D screens, VN/dialogue tools, and a textured PS2 3D world in one project.
detail: The primary NEO-STATION PS2 starter. Initialize, splash, intro, title, and menu remain visible as individual beginner-friendly scenes; gameplay combines shared GameObjects, events, audio, UI, and a camera-authored 3D world.
